from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data from one company's financial report for intangible assets."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock code of the company")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., 2024年第一季度")
    intangible_assets: float | None = Field(description="The intangible assets balance amount in yuan")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the intangible assets amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
